name: architect
descriptionZh: 先勾勒类型、签名和模块结构，再在实现过程中持续校准设计。
descriptionEn: Sketch types, signatures, and module structure before code, then stay in the loop while implementation fills in. Use for /architect, 'architect this', 'design this', or non-trivial work where jumping to code would lock in the wrong shape.

name: arena
descriptionZh: 并行尝试多种方案，选出最佳基线，再吸收其他方案的优点。
descriptionEn: Spawn N parallel candidates at the same task, pick a base, graft the strongest parts of the losers into it. Use for /arena, 'arena this', 'throw it in the arena', or when one attempt at a non-trivial artifact would lock in the wrong shape.

name: automate-me
descriptionZh: 把个人偏好和工作方式整理成 agent 可遵循的专属模式技能。
descriptionEn: Use for "automate me", "create/update/refresh my -mode skill", "turn/capture my preferences or working style into a skill", or wanting agents to follow how the user works. Drafts or revises a personal -mode skill via create-skill + unslop, optionally pulling fresh evidence from recent transcripts.

name: benchmark-checklist
descriptionZh: 审查性能测量的瓶颈、调参、误差、可重复性和相关性，再据此采取行动。
descriptionEn: Vet a perf measurement (limiter, tuning, limits, errors, repeatability, relevance, and whether the work happened) before you report or act on it. Use when you run a benchmark or report a speedup or regression you measured.

name: blast-radius
descriptionZh: 找出改动可能影响的范围，并通过实际运行验证关键假设。
descriptionEn: Find what a change could break somewhere else before it ships, beyond the diff, and prove the one fact it's safe because of by running real code instead of writing it up. Use for 'blast radius of X', 'what could this break', or reviewing a small diff you don't trust.

name: bro
descriptionZh: 用不带术语的日常语言重述上一条消息。
descriptionEn: Restate the last message in plain human language, with no jargon.

name: correct
descriptionZh: 定位 agent 在本项目反复犯的错误，并通过架构、类型、检查或测试让错误难以重现。
descriptionEn: Find the mistakes agents keep repeating in this repo and make each one impossible. Try architecture first, then types, then a lint whose error names the fix, then a test, and write docs last. Prove each check fails on a real past mistake. Repeat this each time the operator corrects you. Use for /correct.

name: create-verification-skill
descriptionZh: 为项目生成验证技能，像用户一样驱动应用，检查界面、命令行或服务行为。
descriptionEn: Generate a project-local verification skill that drives your app the way a user does — any language, framework, or platform. Use for /create-verification-skill, "make a control skill for this repo", or when a project has no scripted way to prove UI/CLI/service behavior.

name: figure-it-out
descriptionZh: 为大型迁移或多部分任务设计可审计的执行手册，并记录假设、实验与决策。
descriptionEn: Design an auditable playbook when no narrower one fits: a large migration, an ambitious multi-part change, or work a human reviews after stepping away. Scales rigor to the task, runs a hypothesis loop, and logs decisions via show-me-your-work. Use for /figure-it-out, 'figure it out', a large migration, or when no narrower playbook applies.

name: how
descriptionZh: 讲解代码库中某项功能如何运行，包括模块边界、调用流程和上手心智模型。
descriptionEn: Use for "how does X work", code walkthroughs before changing something, and placement / ownership / layering questions ("where should this live", "which package owns this", "is this the right layer"). Explains subsystem architecture, runtime flow, onboarding mental models. Use why for motivation.

name: interrogate
descriptionZh: 召集多个模型从不同角度挑战方案或代码，暴露盲点与风险。
descriptionEn: Use for "interrogate", "adversarial review", "multi-model review", "challenge this", "stress test this code", "find blind spots", or "tear this apart". Multiple LLM reviewers challenge changes from independent angles.

name: maintain-verification-skill
descriptionZh: 定期核对项目验证技能和功能地图，实际操作每项功能并提交已证实的修正。
descriptionEn: Periodic pass that keeps a project's verification skill and feature map honest: parallel source readers per feature, one live session driving every feature, at most one PR of proven corrections. Use for /maintain-verification-skill or "audit the verify skill".

name: Make Bot UI
descriptionZh: 构建可通过 webhook 唤起 Grok Bot 的定制界面，并处理密钥输入和 Tailscale 暴露场景。
descriptionEn: Use when building a custom UI (page, dashboard, buttons) that should wake a Grok Bot over a webhook, when the user must provide a webhook sender key, or when exposing that UI on Tailscale.

name: no-comments
descriptionZh: 并行检查代码注释问题，修复接受的发现，并为约束提供结构化表达。
descriptionEn: Spawn Comment Sicko, fix accepted findings, and offer encodings for claimed constraints.

name: poteto-help
descriptionZh: 指导用户配置 PStack、启用 Poteto Mode，并为任务选择合适的技能、流程或原则。
descriptionEn: Guides users through pstack setup, /poteto-mode, and picking the skill, playbook, or principle for a task. Use for /poteto-help, or when the user asks how to install, set up, or use pstack, or which pstack skill fits. Not for requests to do work, even ones that name pstack.

name: Poteto Mode
descriptionZh: 采用 Poteto 的 agent 工作方式：表达简洁具体、谨慎使用子代理、保持代码简单并验证结果。
descriptionEn: poteto's agent style for concise, detailed responses, deliberate subagents, unslopped prose, simple code, and verified work. Use for poteto, /poteto-mode, or requests to work in this style.

name: principle-attack-the-premise
descriptionZh: 当多个修复都因同一前提失败时，先盘点受影响的参与方，再重新审视这个前提。
descriptionEn: Apply when two or more fixes that share one premise have failed the same gate. Take a census of which actors hold the imbalance before the next fix, then question the premise instead of writing another fix that assumes it.

name: principle-boundary-discipline
descriptionZh: 为验证、错误处理和框架适配集中设置边界防护，并让内部逻辑保持纯粹。
descriptionEn: Apply when wiring validation, error handling, or framework adapters. Concentrate guards at system boundaries (CLI, config, network, external APIs); trust internal types and keep business logic in pure functions.

name: principle-build-the-lever
descriptionZh: 面对非平凡任务时构建可重复使用或验证结果的工具，而非手工重复操作。
descriptionEn: Apply to any non-trivial work, not just bulk work: edits, migrations, analyses, checks. Build the tool that does it or proves it (codemod, script, generator, or a skill your subagents follow) instead of working by hand. The tool is the artifact a reviewer can rerun.

name: principle-encode-lessons-in-structure
descriptionZh: 当规则需要重复说明或反复纠正时，将其编码为检查、元数据、运行时约束或脚本。
descriptionEn: Apply when you catch yourself writing the same instruction a second time, or notice a recurring correction. Encode the rule as a lint, metadata flag, runtime check, or script instead of more text.

name: principle-exhaust-the-design-space
descriptionZh: 遇到无先例的界面交互或架构选择时，先构建 2 到 3 个原型并排比较。
descriptionEn: Apply when facing a novel UI interaction or architectural decision with no precedent in the codebase. Build 2-3 competing prototypes and compare side by side before committing.

name: principle-experience-first
descriptionZh: 面对产品、体验或范围取舍时优先考虑用户感受，宁可少做也要打磨完整。
descriptionEn: Apply when product, UX, or feature-scope tradeoffs come up. Choose user delight over implementation convenience; ship fewer polished features over more rough ones.

name: principle-explain-the-number
descriptionZh: 引用或依赖测量数字前，先找出限制因素并验证结果确实来自预期工作。
descriptionEn: Apply before you trust, report, or act on a number you measured: a speedup, a regression, a throughput, a latency, or an eval result. Find what limits it, and rule out that it measured something other than the work you think.

name: principle-fix-root-causes
descriptionZh: 调试时先复现问题，沿症状追到根因，避免用防御性补丁掩盖崩溃。
descriptionEn: Apply when debugging. Trace each symptom to its root cause and fix it there; reproduce first, ask why until you reach it, resist nil-check guards that silence crashes.

name: principle-foundational-thinking
descriptionZh: 编写逻辑前先确定核心数据结构、类型、工作阶段和并发写入关系。
descriptionEn: Apply before writing logic: choosing core types and data structures, sequencing scaffold-vs-feature work, asking what concurrent actors share. Get the data structures right so downstream code becomes obvious.

name: principle-guard-the-context-window
descriptionZh: 上下文变长或输出庞大时，把批量信息移出主对话，只保留摘要。
descriptionEn: Apply when context is filling up: large outputs, long files, repeated reads, fan-out planning. Route bulk to subagents; keep summaries in the main thread, not raw payloads.

name: principle-laziness-protocol
descriptionZh: 重构或添加抽象前先精简，偏向删除和最小可行改动。
descriptionEn: Apply when refactoring, evaluating diff size, or tempted to add abstractions, layers, or signal threading. Bias toward deletion and the smallest change that solves the problem.

name: principle-make-operations-idempotent
descriptionZh: 设计可在崩溃、重启和重试后重复执行并收敛到同一结果的操作。
descriptionEn: Apply when designing commands, lifecycle steps, or processing loops that run amid crashes, restarts, and retries. Converge to the same end state regardless of partial prior runs.

name: principle-migrate-callers-then-delete-legacy-apis
descriptionZh: 引入内部 API 时，同一轮迁移所有调用方并删除旧接口，避免长期保留兼容层。
descriptionEn: Apply when introducing a new internal API while old callers still exist. Migrate callers and delete the old API in the same wave instead of preserving compatibility layers.

name: principle-minimize-reader-load
descriptionZh: 梳理难以追踪的代码时，减少读者需要记住的状态、层级和单调用包装。
descriptionEn: Apply when reviewing or shaping code that's hard to trace. Count layers between question and answer, and hidden state in the reader's head; collapse one-caller wrappers and shrink mutable scope.

name: principle-model-the-domain
descriptionZh: 将重复的数据假设和分支逻辑整理为明确的领域结构，而不是散落在各处。
descriptionEn: Apply when writing stateful logic, or when code branches a lot or repeats a shape assumption across files. Encode the domain in a structure instead of scattered conditionals.

name: principle-never-block-on-the-human
descriptionZh: 可逆事项不必反复等待确认，先推进并展示结果；把确认留给不可逆动作。
descriptionEn: Apply when tempted to ask 'should I do X?' on reversible work. Proceed, present the result, let the human course-correct after the fact; reserve confirmation for irreversible actions.

name: principle-outcome-oriented-execution
descriptionZh: 规划重写或迁移时直接收敛到目标架构，避免保留一次性的过渡状态。
descriptionEn: Apply during planned rewrites and migrations with explicit phase boundaries. Converge on the target architecture; don't preserve smooth intermediate states with throwaway compatibility code.

name: principle-prove-it-works
descriptionZh: 任务完成后检查实际产物和运行结果，而不是只依赖代理自述或编译通过。
descriptionEn: Apply after completing a task, before declaring done. Verify against the real artifact (run the feature, read the actual value, inspect the diff), not a proxy, self-report, or 'it compiles.'

name: principle-redesign-from-first-principles
descriptionZh: 把新需求视为系统自始就应满足的基础条件，从根本上重构设计，而非临时拼接。
descriptionEn: Apply when integrating a new requirement into an existing design. Redesign as if the requirement had been a foundational assumption from day one, instead of bolting it on.

name: principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state
descriptionZh: 多个执行方可能同时写入同一状态时，优先拆分共享所有权，而非事后串行化。
descriptionEn: Apply when concurrent actors might write to the same file, branch, key, or state object. Eliminate the sharing first; serialize structurally only when one shared writer is a real invariant.

name: principle-sequence-verifiable-units
descriptionZh: 把多阶段工作拆成每步都能验证的单元，并按能证明结果的顺序交付。
descriptionEn: Apply to multi-step work (sweeps, migrations, runs of similar edits) and to how you stack commits and PRs. Break work into small units that each end in a verifiable state, check each before the next, and order delivery so the sequence proves itself to a reviewer.

name: principle-subtract-before-you-add
descriptionZh: 开始添加或重写前先移除死代码、重复校验和占位引用，再在简化后的结构上构建。
descriptionEn: Apply when sequencing an addition, refactor, or rewrite. Remove dead code, redundant validators, and stub references first, then build on the simpler base.

name: principle-test-behavior-not-implementation
descriptionZh: 编写测试时通过真实用户路径调用代码，并断言可观察结果，不测试实现细节。
descriptionEn: Apply when you write, change, or keep a test. Call the code the way its users do and assert the result they observe against a literal expected value. If the test would still pass when every imported function returns undefined, rewrite the assertion or delete the test.

name: principle-type-system-discipline
descriptionZh: 设计类型时让非法状态无法表示，在边界解析外部数据，并穷尽处理所有变体。
descriptionEn: Apply when designing types, reviewing a function signature, or writing code in any statically-typed language. Make illegal states unrepresentable, brand semantic primitives, parse external data at boundaries, refuse to lie to the compiler, exhaust variants, derive from authoritative schemas.

name: recall
descriptionZh: 结合近期对话、工作区状态和记录恢复上下文，交付简洁的当前进度摘要。
descriptionEn: Reconstruct your recent working context from your own chat history, live state, and the shared record (user reports, prior fixes, incidents), then hand back a tight current-state brief. Use for 'recall my work on X', 'catch me up', 'what have I been working on', 'where did I leave off', before starting or resuming work.

name: reflect
descriptionZh: 回顾当前对话中的有效经验，并将每条经验落实到现有技能的具体改进。
descriptionEn: Spawn three parallel review subagents over the active transcript, surface learnings, and route each to a concrete edit on an existing skill. Use when the user says reflect.

name: setup-pstack
descriptionZh: 配置 PStack 各角色使用的模型和推理预算，并检测可用模型后写入统一规则。
descriptionEn: Configure which models pstack uses per role and at what reasoning budget. Detects your available models and writes an always-applied rule that overrides the skill defaults. Use for /setup-pstack, "configure pstack models", "pstack budget", or changing pstack's model choices.

name: show-me-your-work
descriptionZh: 为长时间或无人值守任务记录决策、依据和结果，形成可供评审的过程轨迹。
descriptionEn: Keep a reviewable decision trail for long-running or unattended work: a TSV log with one row per decision (what, why, evidence, result). Local by default; commit it when a reviewer needs the trail to trust the result. Use for /show-me-your-work, autonomous or multi-phase runs, or work a human reviews after stepping away.

name: swarm
descriptionZh: 并行派发多个工作者，等待全部完成后汇总一份统一结果。
descriptionEn: Fan out N parallel workers, drain them, and return one report. Use for /swarm, 'swarm this', or parallel coverage, races, gauntlets, and exploration.

name: tdd
descriptionZh: 按测试驱动流程实现功能或修复问题；仅在用户明确要求或存在简单本地测试点时启用。
descriptionEn: Use only when the user explicitly asks for TDD, a failing test, or a regression test, OR when the bug has an obvious cheap local test target. Skip when the test path is unclear, expensive, integration-heavy, or not requested.

name: teach
descriptionZh: 把一段代码或工作过程讲清楚，帮助用户真正理解其行为和背景。
descriptionEn: Explain a body of work plainly so a person actually understands it. Runs the `how` and `why` skills and weaves what they find into one clear explanation. Use for 'teach me this', 'help me really understand X', 'explain this change or subsystem to me'.

name: technical-writing
descriptionZh: 按清晰的信息结构和技术写作规范组织文档、说明、指南与 PR 文案。
descriptionEn: Layered technical-writing standard: Diátaxis structure, Google developer style sentences, STE instruction rules, Global English syntax. Use for /technical-writing or when writing or reviewing docs, RFCs, readmes, PR descriptions, or commit messages.

name: typescript-best-practices
descriptionZh: 编写或阅读 TypeScript 时遵循项目推荐的类型安全实践。
descriptionEn: TypeScript best practices. Use when reading or editing any .ts or .tsx file.

name: unslop
descriptionZh: 润色各类文字，删去生硬的 AI 套话，让表达更自然清晰。
descriptionEn: Cut AI tells from any writing. Must always apply.

name: why
descriptionZh: 查询代码、文档、协作与监控等一手证据，解释设计决策、权衡、回归或事后复盘。
descriptionEn: Use for 'why does X work this way', 'why we picked Y', design rationale, regressions, postmortems, or data-backed thresholds. Discovers available MCPs and queries each evidence category (source control, issue tracker, long-form docs, real-time chat, infrastructure observability, error tracking, product analytics warehouse) in parallel, then returns a cited read on decisions and tradeoffs. Use how for runtime behavior.
